title: PCYC School Holiday Activities - City of Sydney
description: Safe, fun and affordable full-day school holiday programs for school-aged children at PCYC Woolloomooloo - sport, arts, crafts, coding, laser tag and more. Active and Creative Kids vouchers accepted.
longDescription:
PCYC City of Sydney runs structured full-day and half-day school holiday programs for school-aged children at their Woolloomooloo centre. Programs are delivered by qualified coaches and cover a wide range of activities including laser tag, multi-sport, gymnastics, boxing, painting, dance, crafts, coding and skateboarding. Active and Creative Kids vouchers are accepted for eligible activities. Located opposite the Domain Carpark in the heart of the city.

* Full day program: 9am–3pm (drop-off from 8am, pick-up until 4pm)
* Wide variety of activities: laser tag, gymnastics, boxing, coding, skateboarding and more
* Run by qualified coaches with experience working with young people
* Active and Creative Kids vouchers accepted
* Suitable for primary and high school aged children

seoDescription: Full and half-day school holiday programs at PCYC Woolloomooloo - sport, arts, coding and more for school-aged kids. Active & Creative Kids vouchers accepted.

description: Code Camp runs week-long in-person holiday camps for children aged 5–12 covering coding, robotics, stop-motion animation, DJing and more at Sydney locations.
longDescription:
Code Camp inspires kids to get creative with technology these holidays. Children learn valuable new skills, have loads of fun and make new friends through a wide range of in-person camps, including coding, robotics, stop-motion animation, DJing and more. Popular programs include Minecraft Engineers (ages 7–12), Minecraft Minis (ages 5–7), Roblox Legends (ages 7–10) and Robotics Camps (ages 7–12). Camps run 9:30am to 3:30pm with extended hours available at selected venues.

* Coding, robotics, Minecraft, Roblox, DJing and stop-motion animation camps
* Suitable for children aged 5–12 years

What kids will do:
- Make their own bath bombs
- Create slime and perfumes
- Build a lava lamp
- Explore chemical reactions in a fun, safe way

Brought to you by the team at Ashfield Mall, these popular workshops sell out fast — bookings are essential. Located opposite Kmart inside the centre.

title: Featherdale Wildlife Park
description: Get nose-to-nose with wombats, hand-feed kangaroos and spot koalas up close at one of Sydney's best wildlife parks — a guaranteed hit with kids of every age.
longDescription:
Featherdale Wildlife Park in Doonside is one of the best places in Sydney to get up close with Australian animals. With over 1,700 animals across 260 species, it's a hands-on wildlife experience the whole family will love.

Highlights include:
- Hand-feed kangaroos and wallabies
- See koalas, wombats and Tasmanian devils
- Meet reptiles and birds in walk-through aviaries
- Up-close encounters with native Australian wildlife
- Perfect for all ages including toddlers and babies
seoTitle: Featherdale Wildlife Park Sydney – Meet Kangaroos, Koalas & More
seoDescription: Hand-feed kangaroos, meet koalas and spot wombats at Featherdale Wildlife Park in Western Sydney. Open daily, great for all ages.

title: Luna Park Sydney
description: Rides, fairy floss and harbour views — Luna Park is Sydney's most iconic family fun destination right on the water at Milsons Point.
longDescription:
Luna Park Sydney has been delighting families since 1935 and sits in one of the most spectacular locations in the world — right on the harbour at Milsons Point with sweeping views of the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House.

What's on offer:
- Classic rides and thrill rides for all ages
- Toddler and junior rides for little ones
- Carnival games and fairy floss
- Stunning harbour and bridge views
- Special school holiday events and entertainment
- Combine with a ferry ride for extra fun
seoTitle: Luna Park Sydney – Iconic Rides & Harbour Views for the Whole Family
seoDescription: Rides, fairy floss and Sydney Harbour views at Luna Park Milsons Point. Fun for toddlers to teens, open school holidays and weekends.

title: Centennial Parklands – Family Outdoor Fun
description: 580 acres of beautiful parkland in the Eastern Suburbs with playgrounds, cycling, duck ponds, picnic spots and wide open spaces — free to explore any day.
longDescription:
Centennial Parklands is one of Sydney's most beloved green spaces, covering 580 acres right in the heart of the Eastern Suburbs. It's a perfect free day out for families at any time of year.

Things to do:
- Visit the duck and goose ponds
- Free playgrounds for different age groups
- Hire bikes and pedal cars (small fee)
- Wide open lawns for a picnic
- Birdwatching and nature walks
- Seasonal events including Easter egg hunts and summer concerts
- Horse riding nearby (paid)
address: Centennial Park, Oxford Street, Centennial Park NSW 2021
seoTitle: Centennial Parklands Sydney – Free Family Day Out in the Eastern Suburbs
seoDescription: Free playgrounds, duck ponds, cycling and wide open spaces at Centennial Parklands in Sydney's Eastern Suburbs. Perfect for all ages.

title: Sydney Zoo – Western Sydney's Wild Adventure
description: Come face to face with giraffes, gorillas, hippos and hundreds more animals at Sydney Zoo in Bungarribee Park — a brand new world-class zoo in Western Sydney.
longDescription:
Sydney Zoo opened in 2019 in Bungarribee Park, Blacktown, and is Western Sydney's first major zoo. It's a stunning, purpose-built facility where animals live in large, naturalistic habitats.

What you'll see:
- Giraffes and African savannah animals
- Western lowland gorillas
- Hippos and crocodiles
- Australian wildlife including koalas and wombats
- Over 100 species in total

Good to know:
- Located next to Eastern Creek Raceway — easy to find
- Plenty of parking
- Cafe and picnic areas on site
- Great value family tickets available
address: Bungarribee Park, Great Western Highway, Blacktown NSW 2148
seoTitle: Sydney Zoo Western Sydney – Giraffes, Gorillas & More at Bungarribee Park
seoDescription: Meet giraffes, gorillas, hippos and over 100 species at Sydney Zoo in Blacktown. A world-class wildlife experience for the whole family.

title: April School Holidays in Darling Harbour
description: A packed free program at Darling Harbour: Easter Saturday disco with DJs, K-Pop dance classes, a parents' dance-off, tumble zone, Easter Bunny visit, Kids Yoga, circus shows, and roving performers.
address: Tumbalong Park, Darling Harbour, Sydney NSW 2000
longDescription:
Darling Harbour goes all-out for the April school holidays with a full program of free family fun running 4–19 April 2026.

Highlights include an epic School Holiday Disco on Easter Saturday (4 April) with a DJ set, K-Pop dance classes, a parents' dance-off competition, a tumble zone with hula hoops and cartwheels, live performances, and a visit from the Easter Bunny.

Throughout the holidays, catch free Kids Yoga sessions at the Playground Lawn, the Sync or Swim circus show on Saturdays, roving performers across the precinct, and refreshed play equipment at Darling Quarter catering to older kids and tweens.
seoTitle: April School Holidays in Darling Harbour 2026 – Free Family Fun | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free school holiday activities at Darling Harbour 4–19 April 2026: Easter disco, Kids Yoga, circus shows, roving performers and more.

description: Free Easter fun for the whole family at Darling Square: egg hunt with prizes, Easter Bunny visits, inflatable jumping castle, face painting, and twisted balloon art.
longDescription:
Darling Square comes alive for Easter school holidays with a lineup of free activities for kids during the NSW Autumn school break (7–17 April 2026).

* Easter hunt — follow clues around Darling Square to claim a sweet prize
* Easter Bunny hopping around the precinct
* Inflatable jumping castle for kids up to 13 years
* Free face painting
* Free twisted balloon art

With over 50 restaurants on-site, it's also a great spot to stop for a family lunch after all the fun.

seoDescription: Free Easter activities for kids at Darling Square, Sydney: egg hunt, Easter Bunny, jumping castle, face painting and balloon art. No bookings needed.

title: Imagination Station – Space-Themed Activities at Darling Harbour
description: Free drop-in space-themed workshops at Pier Street Underpass: build a rocket, decorate an astronaut mask, design a spaceship, and catch storytimes from Russ the Story Bus. Sensory-friendly.
address: Pier Street Underpass, Darling Harbour, Sydney NSW 2000
longDescription:
The Pier Street Underpass at Darling Harbour transforms into Imagination Station for the April school holidays — a free, all-ages interactive installation where creativity takes flight.

Activities include:

* Building your own rocket
* Decorating an astronaut mask
* Designing a spaceship
* Cosmic painting
* Author storytimes aboard Russ the Story Bus (the travelling library from the Sydney Writers' Festival)
* A giant illustrated art cube by renowned illustrator James Gulliver Hancock

No bookings needed — just drop in. Sensory-friendly activities available throughout.

seoDescription: Free drop-in space-themed craft and storytimes at Pier Street Underpass, Darling Harbour. Build rockets, decorate astronaut masks and more — no bookings needed.

title: School Holiday Performances & Workshops – Darling Harbour
description: Free weekly shows and workshops at Darling Harbour's Playground Lawn: Rhythm n Bubs music classes on Wednesdays, Sync or Swim circus on Saturdays, Sunday party shows, and Kids Yoga.
longDescription:
Every week of the April school holidays, Darling Harbour's Playground Lawn hosts free live performances and workshops for families.

Regular schedule:

* Wednesdays 10:30–11:15am — Rhythm n Bubs music and movement classes with Phoebe Haselden & Co (great for babies and toddlers)
* Saturdays 10:30–11:00am and 11:30am–12:00pm — Sync or Swim circus show
* Sundays 10:30–11:15am — Summer Party with Tiptoe Giants
* Free Kids Yoga sessions throughout the holidays
* Roving performers appearing across the precinct daily

All events are free with no bookings required. Just turn up and enjoy.

seoDescription: Free live performances every week of the April school holidays at Darling Harbour Playground Lawn — circus, music classes, Kids Yoga and more.

title: School Holidays: T-shirt to Tote Printing – Green Square Library
description: Kids aged 8–12 design and carve their own print block then press it onto a recycled t-shirt or tote bag at Green Square Library. An eco-friendly craft workshop — bookings essential.
longDescription:
Get creative and go green at this hands-on printmaking workshop for children aged 8–12 at Green Square Library.

Participants design, carve, and ink up their own custom block, then press it onto a pre-loved t-shirt or tote bag to take home — a unique wearable they've made themselves.

The workshop celebrates sustainability and upcycling, giving second-hand fabric a new life through art.

Parents or guardians must sign in and remain within the library space for the duration of the session. Bookings are essential — spaces are limited.
seoTitle: T-shirt to Tote Printing Workshop – Green Square Library School Holidays 2026 | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Free printmaking workshop for kids 8–12 at Green Square Library. Design and print your own block onto a recycled t-shirt or tote. Saturday 11 April 2026.

Designed for young children aged 1–5, the session features picture books, songs, and rhymes in a relaxed and welcoming environment.

No bookings needed — simply turn up and settle in. A lovely free outing for babies, toddlers, and pre-schoolers during the school holidays.

seoDescription: Free storytime with songs and stories for kids aged 1–5 at Maybanke Community Centre, Pyrmont during the April 2026 school holidays. No bookings needed.

Children take on imaginative building challenges designed to stretch their creativity and problem-solving skills.

The event is sponsored by the Friends of The Hills Library. Please note: parents and carers must remain on the library premises for the full duration of the session. Bookings are essential — register on Eventbrite to secure your child's spot.

seoDescription: Free LEGO building challenges for K–6 kids at Baulkham Hills Library on Thursday 9 April 2026. Bookings essential. Sponsored by Friends of The Hills Library.

title: Look at the Moon – Hurstville Museum & Gallery
description: Discover fun facts about the moon and create lunar-inspired art at Hurstville Museum & Gallery. A 75-minute school holiday workshop for ages 8–12 guided by an artist facilitator.
longDescription:
Join artist facilitators at Hurstville Museum & Gallery for an inspiring lunar-themed art workshop during the school holidays.

Kids aged 8–12 explore fascinating facts about the moon before getting hands-on with art materials, techniques, and mixed-media to create their own moon-inspired artwork to take home.

The session runs for 75 minutes. Children aged 10 and under must have a parent or guardian (aged 16+) remain on the premises for the full duration.

Bookings are essential — register on Eventbrite. Contact the museum at museumgallery@georgesriver.nsw.gov.au or 02 9330 6444 for more information.
seoTitle: Look at the Moon – Free School Holiday Art Workshop at Hurstville Museum 2026 | Little Discoveries
seoDescription: Lunar art workshop for kids 8–12 at Hurstville Museum & Gallery. Thursday 16 April 2026, 2–3:15pm. Free, bookings essential.

longDescription:
